topic: Clean State Management Pattern in Flutter using ValueNotifier

post.topic: Clean State Management Pattern in Flutter using ValueNotifier
post.linkedin_text:
Stop overcomplicating state management in medium Flutter apps.

You do not always need a massive BLoC setup for simple UI states.

ValueNotifier is built right into Flutter, lightweight, and requires zero boilerplate.

→ Create a controller extending ValueNotifier
→ Wrap your widget in a ValueListenableBuilder
→ Update the value and trigger targeted rebuilds

It keeps your code readable and performs surprisingly well for isolated component states.

What is your go-to state management tool for small projects?

slides.title: Stop Overcomplicating *Flutter* State
slides.body: Use ValueNotifier for lightweight, zero-boilerplate component state.

slides.title: The Problem with Heavy State
slides.body: Using complex state management libraries for simple local UI toggles adds unnecessary boilerplate and slows down feature delivery.

slides.title: The ValueNotifier Approach
slides.body: Create a simple controller and listen directly in the widget tree.

slides.title: Consuming the State Cleanly
slides.body: Use ValueListenableBuilder to rebuild only the targeted widget.
